answer: Transactions & Dealings >> Interest & Insurance Question ID: 5530 Country: India Title: I am serving in state bank of india having three children whether it is halal or haram? Question: i am serving in state bank of india having three children whether it is halal or haram Answer ID: 5530 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 607/560=D) It is unlawful to work in bank in which one is involved to write interest accounts. It is unlawful to receive the salary as well. You should keep on seeking forgiveness from Allah and look for any lawful source of income. Do not leave the bank employment until you get a lawful means of income. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
